howToVerify.selectKey: Use the key whose validFrom <= record.savedAt < validUntil (or validUntil null).
howToVerify.documentPayload: [version, docId, showId, ownerId, contentFingerprint, profileFingerprint, docType, savedAt]
howToVerify.fingerprintRule: SHA-256 of the text with CRLF normalised to LF, trailing spaces and tabs stripped per line, then trimmed.
howToVerify.signature: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of the JSON array above, base64-encoded.
